info.headline: Notify NYC - Hispanic Day Parade - 10/11 (MN)
info.description:
Notification issued 10-10-2026 at 03:00 PM.
As part of the Hispanic Day Parade, 5th Avenue will be closed from 43rd Street to 69th Street in Manhattan, at the discretion of the NYPD. Consider alternate routes and allow for additional travel time. Additional road closures in the surrounding area are possible.
For more information, please visit: on.nyc.gov/traffic
